name: Scurry! (Gremlin)
text:
Trigger You roll initiative.

---
Gremlins have a deep, instinctual drive to run and hide whenever someone shows up. A bit like cockroaches, really. You Stride; you must end your movement in a location where you have cover from at least one enemy you can see, and you can't take this action if it's impossible for you to do so. You can Climb, Fly, or Swim instead of Striding if you have the corresponding movement type.
